library.name: Jepyso player
library.description: The exercise player of Oksigenia Jepyso, a built copy of its web app (index.html, its JavaScript modules, the exercise catalogue and the figures in modelos/). It bundles three.js, under the MIT licence. The 3D figures and their stills are content under their own terms, stated in reproductor/modelos/LICENSE-FIGURES.md (and in the Jepyso repository).
